author: fester
body: A self-check for the SPIR-V binary encoder. It hand-builds the smallest well-formed GLCompute module -- capability, memory model, an entry point named main, a void() function that just returns -- encodes it to words, and validates the stream. It then validates a deliberately miscounted module, because a validator that only ever says VALID is indistinguishable from one that does nothing.

author: fester
body: A single word whose header claims three words but stands alone. The walk must refuse it rather than read two words that are not there.

author: fester
body: Two well-shaped modules that a driver would still refuse: one defines the id 1 twice, one names an id at the bound. The structural walk passes both; the id walk must not.

author: fester
body: A module whose ids are all unique and in range, but whose OpReturnValue names id 9, which nothing defines. Structural and id-integrity pass; the reference check must not.
